text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон has managed to leave
quite a mark
on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One day, while we're still basking in the
glory of
our accomplishments...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Something big happens!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I-I'm making my international debut?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Now that she's a top Umadol, everybody
wants a
piece of Смарт Фалкон. Naturally,
that includes
the international markets.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
You've received an invitation to appear at the
DWC.

text_block_list.text: The DWC?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: You mean that DWC? The Dokidol ☆ World ☆ Concert?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Where super-duper ultra popular idols
from all
around the world gather to
compete?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: They're even asking you to be the headliner!

text_block_list.text: Headliner? Isn't that the star attraction?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Am I about to become an international
hit?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I wanna go for it, of course!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If it means that my songs will be heard
by even
more people...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'll shine bright on any stage!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can see the determination gleaming
brightly in
her eyes—but there's also a
trace of hesitation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I am a bit anxious, sure. I mean, I have
no idea
if I'll succeed or not.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I might even end up disappointing my
fans...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But still... Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I have you watching over me from
backstage, I
bet I can do it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: We can do it if we're together!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
From zero to Umadol, and from Umadol
to world
sensation...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Nothing's impossible if the two of us are
together.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's why...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
You're going to stand on center stage—of the
world!

text_block_list.text: That's right! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As a top Umadol, my next stage is the
world!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is appearing at the DWC.
The news
spreads like wildfire until it's
all anyone can talk
about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then, the big day of the DWC
competition
arrives.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoa...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Falcooo!
You can do it!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
You're gonna do great!
Get out there
and move the whole world with
your
music!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Did they all come to see me
off?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
They even made banners. Look! "Show
the world
your true strength!"
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
With everybody believing in me like this,
there's
no way I can return home with my
tail between my
legs.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Whew...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Thanks for cheering me on, everyone! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make my overseas debut a
success!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So keep believing in me, and thanks for
the
continued support! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I love you all!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
